description.text: Cards released on 18 July 2009 for the film known in English as Arceus and the Jewel of Life. Unlike the earlier movie sheets and half decks, they were sold in random packs like an expansion. The film's Pokémon appear as Pokémon M, a new kind of Pokémon SP that took the place of Owner's Pokémon after the changes of the Platinum years; Spiky-eared Pichu and Arceus each come in three versions with special holofoil, and the Energy cards have new artwork. Every card carries the film's logo.
